business_scope.primary_industry_name: Vessel Hull and Cargo Damage Marine Claims Inspection Survey

applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Limited bilateral investment protection arrangements with the United States and the United Kingdom (historical agreements)
Belize is a member of the Caribbean Community (CARICOM) Investment Code

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Money Laundering and Terrorism (Prevention) Act, Chapter 104, as amended; International Business Companies Act, Chapter 270, as amended; Companies (Beneficial Ownership) Regulations, 2018 under the Companies Act; Financial Intelligence Unit Act, Chapter 104A; Compliance Guidelines issued by the Belize Financial Intelligence Unit.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of passport for each beneficial owner and director
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent passport authority / Notary Public in country of residence

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of residential address (utility bill or bank statement)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Public utility entity / regulated financial institution / Notary Public

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter confirming client identity and financial standing
Professional and character reference letter from an attorney-at-law or CPA
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Qualified legal or accounting professional in country of residence / Notary Public

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all directors, shareholders, beneficial owners, authorized signatories, and ultimate beneficial owners against the Belize Financial Intelligence Unit's consolidated list, OFAC SDN list, UN Security Council sanctions list, EU restrictive measures list, and domestic Belizean sanctions lists. Enhanced due diligence (EDD) is mandatory if any person is identified as a Politically Exposed Person (PEP), or holds a family or close associate relationship with a PEP, and requires registered agent approval and notification to the Belize Financial Intelligence Unit. Terrorist financing risk assessments and targeted financial sanctions screening must be completed within one business day before incorporation.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Belize Companies and Corporate Affairs Registry online search and reservation portal (accessed via licensed registered agents; official public portal at https://www.bccar.bz)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Statutory requirement that the proposed corporate name be expressed in English or in a Latin script transliteration where the underlying language uses non-Roman characters. The name may include Roman-alphabet accented characters. All corporate names must be distinguishable from existing registered names and must not be a blank or generic designation. For International Business Companies, the name may be in English; no separate local-language or transliterated version is required, provided the name is fully reproducible in the Belizean registry database.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon name rejection, the applicant through a licensed registered agent may file a written administrative appeal with the Registrar of Companies and Corporate Affairs within 14 days of receipt of the rejection notice. The appeal must state the grounds for distinctiveness, submit official documentary evidence supporting any authorization from the competent ministerial body for prohibited words (where applicable), and request reconsideration. If the Registrar denies the appeal, the applicant may apply to the Belize High Court for judicial review within 30 days of the denial. The name reservation may be extended for an additional 30-day period by payment of the extension fee and submission of a formal extension request, provided no third-party challenge is pending.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not permissible for the statutory registered office. The registered office of an International Business Company must be a physical address within Belize, maintained by a licensed registered agent. Virtual or purely digital offices are not accepted. However, a service address for correspondence may be a virtual address, separate from the registered office.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Moderate-low: estimated 5-8% risk of an unannounced physical on-site inspection per year for a low-risk marine surveying IBC, given the statutory requirement for a physical registered office and periodic supervisory inspections by the Belize Financial Intelligence Unit and the International Financial Services Commission. Random or risk-based inspections are possible under AML/CFT regulations.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Company name search and reservation fee (one name)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark and official government apostille fees

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for corporate legal opinions

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Business Companies Act, Cap. 270, Laws of Belize, Revised Edition 2020, as amended by the IBC (Amendment) Act 2021; ss. 4–6 (incorporation and constitutional documents), s. 5 (certificate contents), s. 33 (registered office and agent), ss. 41–47 (directors and officers); ancillary licensing under the Trade Licensing Act, Cap. 307, the Belize Port Authority Act, Cap. 234, and the Insurance Act, Cap. 316.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Companies Registry, Corporate Affairs Registry, Ministry of Finance, Government of Belize, Belize City, Belize
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum and Articles of Association, together with an Incorporation Statement (Form IBC-1), lodged under s. 4 of Cap. 270
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital; authorized capital may be denominated in any currency (commonly US$50,000) and shares may be issued nil-paid or partly paid; no escrow or deposit account requirement at incorporation
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the Company accept the subscription for and allotment of its initial share issue, and that the authorized share capital structure described in the Articles of Association is hereby ratified and confirmed. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the registered office in Belize, as maintained by the licensed registered agent, is adopted as the statutory registered office of the Company. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the individuals listed in Schedule A are elected first directors, serving until the annual general meeting. RESOLVED FURTHER, that [Name] is appointed President, [Name] Secretary, and [Name] Treasurer, each at the pleasure of the Board, with authority to open bank accounts, execute statutory filings, and approve incidental expenses.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Companies Registry, Belize City (application submitted through a licensed registered agent)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name reservation request with three ranked name options, ensuring compliance with s. 5(2) of Cap. 270 (no restricted words such as 'Bank', 'Trust', or 'Insurance' without special authorization, and no resemblance to existing names). Pay the nominal search fee and obtain written name clearance before proceeding.
required_dossiers: Name reservation application (Form N-1)
Certified passport copies of proposed shareholders and directors
Proof of residential address (utility bill or bank statement dated within three months)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused, file a fresh application with alternative names or appeal to the Registrar within 14 days; statutory revision fees apply.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Execution of Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Registered Agent (IBC service provider), Belize City
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the Memorandum and Articles of Association specifying share classes, authorized capital, director quorum, and indemnity provisions compliant with Cap. 270. The subscriber executes the documents before a notary public, and the executed set is delivered to the licensed registered agent for countersignature, retention, and subsequent lodgment.
required_dossiers: Draft Memorandum and Articles of Association
Subscriber particulars and notarized signatures
AML/KYC file: director backgrounds, source-of-funds declaration, and bank references
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Registry drafting queries are cured by executing a supplemental amendment or re-executing corrected pages prior to formal filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing of Incorporation Documents and Payment of Government Fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Companies Registry, Corporate Affairs Registry, Ministry of Finance, Belize City
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Lodge the executed Memorandum and Articles of Association, the Incorporation Statement (Form IBC-1), and the registered agent's written consent with the Registrar. Pay the US$200 government filing fee together with stamp duty, and obtain a dated receipt and application tracking number.
required_dossiers: Executed Memorandum and Articles of Association
Incorporation Statement (Form IBC-1)
Written consent of the licensed registered agent
Government filing fee and stamp duty receipt
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If documents are queried, rectify the noted defect within the Registrar's 30-day correction window; otherwise statutory fees are forfeited and the application must be re-lodged.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of the Certificate of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon satisfactory review, the Registrar issues the Certificate of Incorporation bearing the company number and date of incorporation, conferring full legal personality on the IBC. The registered agent retrieves the certificate and places it in secure custody with the statutory registers.
required_dossiers: Application receipt and tracking reference
Registry approval note (internal)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Discrepancies in the certificate (name spelling or date) are corrected by filing a Notice of Correction with the Registrar within 10 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: First Board Meeting: Share Subscription, Registered Office Adoption, and Officer Appointments
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors (convened by the incorporator or subscriber)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Hold the first board meeting or pass written resolutions to: (i) accept the subscriber's share subscription and allot the initial shares; (ii) adopt the registered office maintained by the licensed registered agent as the statutory address; (iii) elect the first directors listed in Schedule A; (iv) appoint the President, Secretary, and Treasurer; and (v) ratify authorized signatories for bank accounts and payment rails.
required_dossiers: Subscription agreement and share application
First board meeting minutes or written resolutions
Schedule A of director appointments
Consents to act executed by directors and officers
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Any procedural omission in convening the meeting is ratified by a subsequent written resolution executed by all directors under s. 41(4) of Cap. 270.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registered Agent and Office Confirmation and Registry Notices
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Confirm the registered office address in Belize City, file any required notice of registered office and particulars of directors and officers, and update the minute book, register of members, and other statutory records maintained at the registered agent's office.
required_dossiers: Notice of registered office (Form IBC-RO)
Register of directors, officers, and members
Registered agent service agreement
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Late filing of the registered office notice is cured by paying the prescribed late fee and submitting the delinquent notice within the next 30 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Trade License and Marine Survey Occupational Licensing Applications
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Belize Trade Licensing Board, Ministry of Investment; Belize Port Authority; Office of the Supervisor of Insurance (where marine claims adjusting is undertaken)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Apply for the Trade License for marine surveying services under Cap. 307, obtain the Belize Port Authority marine surveyor occupational endorsement under Cap. 234, and register with the Supervisor of Insurance as a marine claims adjuster if the company will adjust or settle claims on behalf of underwriters.
required_dossiers: Trade License application form
Certificate of Incorporation and registered agent letter
Lease or title documents for business premises
Professional qualifications of marine surveyors (IIMS, SNAME, or naval architect certification)
Police record certificates and AML/CFT compliance manual
Port Authority surveyor endorsement application
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Licensing denial or conditioning is cured by appealing to the Minister under s. 17 of Cap. 307 or by satisfying the additional conditions within 30 days.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Belize Trade Licensing Board, Ministry of Investment, Government of Belize; Belize Port Authority (marine surveyor occupational endorsement); Office of the Supervisor of Insurance, Central Bank of Belize (marine claims adjusting, where applicable)
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Trade License for Marine Surveying Services (vessel hull and cargo damage inspection), together with a Marine Surveyor Occupational Endorsement under the Belize Port Authority Act (Cap. 234)

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environment, Ministry of Sustainable Development, Climate Change and Disaster Risk Management, Belize
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Registration / Low Impact — office-based professional survey services; self-classified as a non-scheduled activity under the Environmental Impact Assessment Regulations, 2021; no full EIA Report required
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Compliance with the Belize Effluent Limitations Guidelines (no industrial wastewater; office sanitary discharge to municipal sewer); solid waste manifest to licensed disposal sites; no VOC point-source emissions above Belize Air Quality Regulations, 2021 thresholds; vessel inspection work generates no hazardous discharge beyond waste oil analysis samples, which must be transported by licensed hazardous waste carriers

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety inspection and certificate from the Belize National Fire Service; structural and occupational safety clearance from the Belize Building Authority and the Belize City Council for office premises and pier-side survey points; registration with the Belize Social Security Board and compliance with the Labour Act (Cap. 297) for employee workplace safety; mandatory port access induction and personal flotation device/PPE compliance for marine survey operations

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Belize Tax Service Department (BTSD), Ministry of Finance, Economic Development and Investment; online portal: https://www.belizetaxservice.gov.bz. The Belize International Financial Services Commission (IFSC) separately administers IBC incorporation, annual returns, and economic substance filings.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Step 1: Engage a locally licensed Registered Agent to incorporate the International Business Company (IBC) under the International Business Companies Act (Cap. 270); the Companies and Corporate Affairs Registry (CCAR) issues the Certificate of Incorporation, which serves as the statutory entity identifier. Step 2: Apply to the BTSD for a Taxpayer Registration Number (TRN) only where the IBC has Belize-source activity, employs local residents, or seeks voluntary GST registration; the IBC Act section 7(1) tax exemption certificate is issued through the IFSC and obviates income and business tax filing. Step 3: Where GST registration is required or elected, submit Form GST-001 to the BTSD GST Unit together with the Certificate of Incorporation, registered office address, and director details. Step 4: File the annual economic substance return with the IFSC and the annual IBC return with the CCAR; the foreign-owned IBC must maintain an agent, registered office, and statutory records in Belize.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No US-style check-the-box election exists; Belize law classifies the IBC as a juridical person subject to a 50-year statutory tax exemption (income, dividends, capital gains, stamp duty, inheritance tax, and exchange controls). Available elections: (i) continuation or redomiciliation as a Belize IBC or as a foreign company under IBC Act sections 132 to 144; (ii) election to convert to a domestic company under the Companies Act, thereby accepting standard Belize tax exposure; (iii) election of the relevant activity category and geographic source treatment under the International Business Companies (Economic Substance) Act, 2019; (iv) election to register under the GST Act as an exporter for zero-rating and input credit recovery. Hybrid mismatch elections are not recognized in domestic law.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: General Sales Tax (GST) under the General Sales Tax Act (Cap. 298) - a destination-based, single-stage turnover tax administered by the BTSD
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: BZD 50,000 gross annual taxable turnover (GST Registration Regulations, Cap. 298), approximately USD 25,000 at the fixed BZD/USD 2:1 peg; an IBC making no taxable supply to persons in Belize is outside the registration threshold, but voluntary registration is available to claim export zero-rating refunds
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time fiscal clearance, e-invoicing API, continuous transaction controls, or digital stamping requirement is in force as of the current compliance cycle. GST-registered businesses must issue sequentially numbered GST invoices bearing the supplier TRN, recipient details, tax fraction, and 12.5% or 0% rate; records must be preserved for six years. Export declarations are processed through ASYCUDA World by the Belize Customs Department; designated large taxpayers file electronically, while IBCs without local taxable supplies maintain only exempt status records.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: A 0% GST rate applies to goods physically exported within 90 days of supply and to specific exported services under Schedule 2 of the GST Act where the recipient is a non-resident insurer or underwriter operating outside Belize and the service is performed for an insurable interest situated outside Belize. Marine hull and cargo damage survey reports and claims inspection certificates issued to non-resident underwriters qualify if the engagement letter, survey location, and payment via Underwriter_Wire or Wise evidence foreign consideration and no direct benefit accrues to a person in Belize. Input GST on local overheads is apportioned and refunded by the BTSD within 30 days of a verified claim under section 50 of the GST Act.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (air or sea) filed via ASYCUDA World with the Belize Customs Department
Bill of Lading or Airway Bill evidencing physical export, or signed engagement letter from the non-resident insurer for services
GST invoice bearing the serial number, TRN, and explicit 0% rate
Commercial invoice and the signed marine survey/claims inspection certificate
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank credit confirmation from the overseas underwriter evidencing foreign currency receipt
Copy of the IBC Certificate of Incorporation and IFSC economic substance filing acknowledgment
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The BTSD may open a six-year retrospective audit under section 66 of the GST Act; where zero-rating is dishonestly claimed the 0% rate is reversed with output tax reassessed at 12.5%, interest accrues at 10% per annum from the original due date, monthly penalties of 10% of the tax apply (capped at 50% of total tax), and criminal conviction under section 92 is punishable by a fine of up to BZD 50,000 and imprisonment for up to three years. Clawback extends to previously refunded input credits, and fraudulent claims are reportable to the Belize Financial Intelligence Unit; the IBC statutory exemption does not shield against GST or customs evasion sanctions.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Belize (CBB), established under the Central Bank of Belize Act (Chapter 262, Laws of Belize); the CBB administers the Exchange Control Act (Chapter 36) and supervises all licensed financial institutions acting as authorized dealers.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Belize Dollar (BZD) is pegged to the US Dollar at BZ$2.00 = US$1.00 since 1976. Current-account convertibility is freely available through licensed authorized dealers for trade in goods and services; capital-account transactions by resident persons require CBB prior approval, and profit remittances by resident companies are conditional on tax clearance and documentary verification. International Business Companies (IBC, Chapter 270) are statutorily classified as non-resident and are expressly exempt from the Exchange Control Act; they may hold foreign currency freely, retain all offshore earnings, and repatriate dividends, interest, and liquidation proceeds without CBB permits. Marine insurance survey fee receivables are typically USD-denominated, which materially eliminates conversion friction; onshore BZD/USD conversion is administered at pegged parity and parallel-market deviation is minimal.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under the Exchange Control Regulations, resident exporters of goods and services must repatriate export proceeds to an authorized dealer in Belize within the CBB-designated period (commonly 90 days from invoice maturity or date of export) and offer the foreign currency for conversion to BZD at the official pegged rate, unless a specific exemption is granted. IBCs holding a valid certificate are outside the exchange control regime: survey fee receivables from foreign underwriters may be credited directly to the IBC's USD offshore account without surrender, conversion, or time-limit constraints, provided funds originate from legitimate marine insurance survey operations.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Offshore IBC USD Account (International Banking Act licensed)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility Rating: MEDIUM for low-value USD aggregation and outbound disbursements (primarily Wise and Payoneer); LOW for any BZD-denominated or domestic clearing function. Legal Constraints: Belize does not license standalone electronic money institutions; any money transmission within Belize requires a money services provider authorization under the Banks and Financial Institutions Act, and a foreign EMI is not an authorized dealer under the Exchange Control Act, so it cannot hold BZD clearing accounts or settle domestic obligations. Wise may be maintained as a secondary rail for underwriter fee receipts below USD 25,000 per transaction, but the primary treasury function — capital injection, claims disbursement, and correspondent clearing — must be executed through a licensed Belize bank to preserve AML/CFT compliance and correspondent banking integrity.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Remote onboarding is generally permitted for non-resident IBCs at Belize domestic and international banks. The Money Laundering (Prevention and Control) Act and CBB AML Guidelines allow identity verification through notarized certified copies of passports, a video-conference interview with directors, and a professional introducer reference from a regulated foreign bank; therefore directors are not required to appear physically. Physical presence may be waived where the ultimate beneficial owner has no sanctions exposure and the file includes the IBC's Certificate of Formation, Register of Directors and Members, registered agent's banking reference, and a Source of Wealth statement. Certain international banks may nevertheless require one director or the registered agent to attend an in-person interview at the bank's head office before activation.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident IBC with an opaque beneficial ownership chain or nominee director/shareholder arrangement
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certificate of Formation, Certificate of Good Standing, Register of Directors, Register of Members, Beneficial Ownership Return filed with the Belize Companies and Corporate Affairs Registry, passport copies, proof of residential address, registered agent's professional reference, and sworn UBO declaration with Source of Wealth/Source of Funds statement.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Receipts from insurance underwriters or reinsurers in high-risk or sanctioned jurisdictions, or involving vessels flagged on OFAC/UN sanctions lists
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Underwriter's license and regulatory status evidence, insurance broker's compliance attestation, per-engagement sanctions screening report, IMO vessel number and flag verification, hull policy schedule or cargo manifest, engagement contract, and surveyor's statutory license and professional indemnity certificate.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-velocity fund flows inconsistent with a marine surveyor's fee pattern, including rapid pass-through of claim proceeds
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Signed engagement contracts and issued invoices, survey docket register cross-referencing case numbers, claims settlement mandate from the underwriter, repair-yard or shipyard agreements, and a written funds-flow rationale memorandum.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Payments routed via multiple correspondent banks in third countries (e.g., Hong Kong, UAE, Turkey) lacking commercial substance
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: SWIFT correspondent chain disclosure, commercial rationale letter, IBC tax residence certificate, current management or audited accounts, and a letter of good standing from the Belize registered agent and licensed corporate services provider.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Capital injections must be remitted by SWIFT MT103 from the beneficial owner's own account at a financial institution in a FATF-compliant jurisdiction; the wire narrative must state 'Capital Contribution — Belize IBC Act (Cap. 270)' or 'Shareholder Loan — [IBC Name]' and must avoid third-party payments. Before credit finalization, the authorized dealer requires a board resolution authorizing the allotment, an updated register of members, the registered agent's acceptance letter, and a completed CDD file; purpose code 'Equity Injection' referencing the IBC structure is applied. Amounts above USD 250,000 trigger enhanced due diligence including Source of Funds documentation and a 30-day verification period prior to unrestricted account operation.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound settlements (underwriter fee disbursements, claims payments, repair-yard transfers, and beneficiary payments) are cleared via SWIFT MT103 through the Belize authorized dealer's correspondent network (typically JPMorgan, Bank of America, or Wells Fargo). For physical survey equipment imports or any tangible trade element, a sight Commercial Letter of Credit may be issued by the domestic bank via SWIFT MT700/MT710; however, as a services-based ISIC 5222 business, MT103 is the dominant rail. Payments exceeding USD 50,000 must be supported by invoice, contract, and, where applicable, a tax clearance certificate from the Belize Tax Service; insurance claims disbursements below USD 25,000 may alternatively clear through Wise as a secondary rail.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: USD/BZD spot conversions at the official pegged rate (BZ$2.00 = US$1.00) executed through CBB-licensed authorized dealers
USD/BZD plain-vanilla foreign exchange forwards (tenors up to 12 months) with an authorized dealer under CBB general permission
Offshore USD/BZD non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) with OECD-domiciled counterparty banks, given the absence of an active onshore NDF market
Cross-currency swaps restricted to matched USD/EUR or USD/GBP receivables and booked offshore, outside the Belize domestic banking perimeter

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return for International Business Company (IBC)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of International Business Companies, Companies and Corporate Affairs Registry (CCAR), Belize City
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 90 calendar days after each anniversary of incorporation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalties as prescribed under the IBC Act; the company ceases to be in Good Standing; continued default for two consecutive years is a ground for administrative strike-off and subsequent dissolution.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Government License / Renewal Fee for standard IBC authorized capital tier not exceeding USD 50,000
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Revenue Unit, Companies and Corporate Affairs Registry (CCAR), Belize City
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on or before the anniversary of incorporation; usually processed concurrently with the Annual Return within the 90-day renewal window
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: A late payment surcharge of 10% of the annual fee is imposed after the prescribed grace period; non-payment for two successive years exposes the IBC to strike-off, asset vesting in the Registrar, and dissolution.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Beneficial Ownership Confirmation and Register of Members update
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Licensed registered agent in Belize City, with records accessible to the Belize Financial Intelligence Unit upon lawful request
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: At each annual renewal cycle; any share transfer or beneficial ownership change during the year must be recorded within 14 calendar days of the change event
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Monetary penalties under the Belize Beneficial Ownership Act and AML/CFT regulations for false statements or omission; persistent non-compliance may result in director disqualification and referral to the Financial Intelligence Unit.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Registered Agent and Registered Office Renewal / Good Standing Certification
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Licensed registered agent and registered office in Belize City
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On each anniversary of incorporation before the Annual Return and Government Fee are submitted
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-payment of agent fees allows the registered agent to resign upon notice; failure to maintain a registered office in Belize is an immediate ground for administrative strike-off by the Registrar.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: None for a Belize IBC under the IBC Act. There is no mandatory independent audit threshold based on turnover, assets, or revenue. An audit becomes mandatory only if required by the company's own articles, by a written shareholder resolution, or by a separate regulatory license requiring audited financial statements.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: The IBC Act does not prescribe a statutory accounting framework. Belize IBCs are exempt from filing financial statements. Where financial statements are voluntarily prepared for marine insurance surveyor clients, underwriters, or lenders, IFRS is the customary framework used by Belize offshore service providers.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Each year, before the Annual Return is filed, the directors must provide the registered agent with an annual confirmation certificate identifying all current members, ultimate beneficial owners, share transfers during the year, and any changes to nominee arrangements. The registered agent is required to update the on-site beneficial ownership register and the Register of Members, cancel and reissue share certificates where necessary, and retain the confirmation certificate as part of the statutory records. The confirmation is not filed publicly, but it must be produced to competent authorities on lawful demand.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Not required by statute; USD 2,500 – USD 5,000 if voluntarily commissioned by shareholders or an insurer

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% — Belize IBC statutory zero-rate exemption (standard domestic corporate CIT headline rate is 25%, but IBCs are statutorily exempt from income tax).
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Full tax-holiday effect under section 6(2) of the International Business Companies Act (Cap. 270): exemption from Belize income tax, capital gains tax, stamp duty, and all withholding taxes; no alternative minimum tax, no thin-capitalisation rules, and no CFC attribution for non-resident owners.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: IBC Annual Return — Belize Companies and Corporate Affairs Registry (CCAR) one-page annual declaration filed electronically through the Belize Online e-Registry; no standard income tax return (Form IB-1/A-I) is issued to a tax-exempt IBC.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Filed by 31 March immediately following the calendar year end, or within 90 days after an adopted non-calendar fiscal year-end; extension of 30 days available upon written application to the Registrar.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Exact legal name and unique IBC registration number of the Belize International Business Company.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Use the name and number exactly as stated on the Certificate of Incorporation; no translation or abbreviation is permitted.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered office address in Belize and full particulars of the licensed registered agent maintaining the registered office.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Provide the Belize physical address of the licensed registered agent; appointing a local resident agent is mandatory for non-resident owners.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Register of directors, officers, and shareholders, including names, addresses, and nationality of all non-resident principals.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: List beneficial owners and directors; IBC law permits nominee officers but the beneficial ownership register must be maintained at the registered agent's office.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration of continued tax-exempt status and confirmation that no Belize-sourced commercial, trading, or insurance survey activity has been undertaken in Belize.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A non-resident director or authorised signatory must countersign the declaration; conducting marine cargo surveys inside Belize without domestic licensing would void the exemption.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Fiscal year-end date and statement of whether audited financial statements are required.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: State the adopted accounting reference date; an IBC carrying on a marine insurance survey business should attach internally prepared management accounts even though statutory audit is waived.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing surcharge of BZD 100 per month; continued default triggers strike-off from the Register, a BZD 500 reinstatement fee, and automatic director disqualification for 5 years; false declarations attract summary fines of up to BZD 50,000 and imprisonment.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Economic Substance Return (Form ESR-01) — filed annually through the Belize Economic Substance Unit of the International Financial Services Commission (IFSC) online portal for all IBCs carrying on a relevant activity.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 60 days after the end of the financial year (for a 31 December year-end, due by 1 March); a curative filing window of up to 90 days is available under the Economic Substance Regulations.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Classification of the relevant activity performed by the IBC.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Select 'Insurance' for underwriting or claims-settlement intermediation, or 'Distribution and Service Centre' where the core marine survey and loss-adjustment function is performed.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross revenue derived from the relevant activity in Belize and abroad.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report marine survey fee income, claims administration commissions, and any cargo-inspection charges; passive investment income is separately disclosed.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Operating expenditure, physical premises, equipment, and full-time employee headcount in Belize.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Quantify the Belize office footprint, marine survey equipment, and resident surveyors; a pure subcontracted model outside Belize is an automatic substance failure.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Core income-generating activities (CIGA) actually performed in Belize.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Describe on-the-ground vessel hull and cargo damage inspection, weather-damage causation analysis, survey report approval, and claims recommendation decisions made in Belize.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration of tax residency in another jurisdiction, if any.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If the IBC is resident for tax purposes in Hong Kong, the UAE, or another approved jurisdiction, provide supporting evidence and confirm the equivalent substance standard is met there.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: First violation: fixed penalty of BZD 25,000; repeated non-compliance: BZD 100,000 per year; knowingly false statements attract imprisonment up to 3 years and criminal fines; persistent default can result in strike-off and loss of IBC tax-exempt status.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% — dividends and all distributions paid by a Belize IBC to non-resident shareholders are statutorily exempt from Belize withholding tax under the International Business Companies Act.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Domestic exemption makes DTA relief unnecessary for Belize-sourced dividend flows. If a foreign payer requires treaty documentation, the IBC must: (1) file a written application with the Belize Income Tax Department requesting a Tax Exemption or Belize Tax Residence Certificate (TRC); (2) attach Certificate of Incorporation, beneficial ownership schedule, latest annual return receipt, and Economic Substance (ESR-01) compliance receipt; (3) obtain the TRC within approximately 6–8 weeks; (4) deliver the TRC to the foreign withholding agent; (5) where the payer is a U.S. person, rely on the zero-rate exemption and, if challenged, the exchange-of-information mechanisms under the U.S.–Belize TIEA, as no comprehensive income tax treaty exists.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory IBC rate: 0% for outbound royalties, license fees, and debt interest. A non-exempt Belize domestic company would incur 12.5% withholding on interest, royalties, and management fees paid to non-residents under the Income and Business Tax Act, but an exempt IBC is carved out. Belize's limited treaty network provides no operative reduction below the domestic exemption.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: BZD 1,000,000 (approximately USD 500,000) annual related-party gross fee income — above this threshold a limited-scope local file recording remuneration for marine survey services, claims adjustment fees, and cost-sharing arrangements with foreign underwriters should be contemporaneously documented and retained for the ESR-01 review.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Applicable — the Belize Economic Substance Act (2019), enacted as Part VIIIA of the IBC Act, and the International Business Companies (Economic Substance) Regulations require every IBC conducting a relevant activity (including insurance, financing and leasing, shipping, and distribution and service centres) to demonstrate: a physical office in Belize, adequate full-time employees, proportionate local expenditure, and core income-generating activities performed in Belize. A marine insurance surveyor must retain vessel inspection files, causal-analysis workpapers, and board minutes evidencing Belize-based decision-making; failure renders the company a passive shell and triggers reclassification as a taxable domestic company at the 25% corporate rate.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion and False Exemption Declaration
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using IBC tax-exempt status to conceal actual Belize-sourced commercial activity, such as performing marine hull and cargo surveys inside Belize for Belizeian insureds, collecting commissions from local underwriters, and failing to declare that conduct on the annual IBC declaration.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fine of up to BZD 50,000 plus a civil penalty equal to 100% of the unpaid tax; restitution of all avoided income tax; imprisonment of up to 5 years under section 132 of the Income and Business Tax Act; automatic reclassification and retrospective taxation at 25% for the years of concealment.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are jointly and severally liable for the full tax deficiency; the court may impose a travel ban, passport surrender, disqualification from managing any Belize company for 5 years, and custodial sentences for knowing participation.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company and Economic Substance Failure
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating a substance-less Belize IBC that only re-invoices foreign marine survey fees, holds no physical office, employs no resident surveyors, and fails to file the annual ESR-01 economic substance return.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Penalty of BZD 25,000 for the first offending year and BZD 100,000 for each subsequent year; mandatory conversion to a domestic taxable company subject to the 25% CIT rate; exchange of information with foreign tax administrations under the OECD Global Forum and TIEA network.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Personal assessment of penalties against directors under the recovery provisions of the Income and Business Tax Act; disqualification orders; forced repatriation of offshore funds; in egregious cases, contempt proceedings and imprisonment for defiance of substance-compliance directions.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: AML and Money Laundering in Insurance Claims Handling
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Facilitating fraudulent marine cargo claims, commingling underwriter claim funds with operating accounts, settling high-value cash claims above BZD 15,000 without a customer due diligence file, or wiring claims proceeds to sanctioned jurisdictions.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Upon conviction, a fine of up to BZD 1,000,000 or twice the value of laundered property, imprisonment of up to 12 years, and confiscation of all tainted proceeds; administratively, the IFSC may suspend or revoke the statutory marine insurance surveyor license and report the entity to the Financial Intelligence Unit.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The Money Laundering (Prevention of Terrorism) Act imposes strict personal liability on compliance-designated officers; directors face asset-freeze orders, travel bans, extradition proceedings, and a minimum non-parole term of 7 years for knowing complicity in claim-fund laundering.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Fraudulent Asset Stripping and Insolvency Fraud
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Disguising dividend distributions or related-party loan repayments to non-resident shareholders while the marine insurance survey company is insolvent, or stripping statutory claim reserves from the Belize IBC to defeat underwriter and insured recourse claims.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Transactions voidable under the Belize Insolvency Act; the court may order recovery of the full transferred value plus interest and costs; the responsible officer is subject to automatic disqualification from acting as an insolvency practitioner or director for up to 10 years.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Civil veil-piercing: directors must personally restore dissipated claim reserves and estate assets; where forged survey reports or fraudulent claim documents are found, criminal fraud prosecution carries imprisonment of up to 10 years and a standing worldwide asset-freezing order.
